elements.title: IKEA Ego 3D Dataset Overview

figure.caption: Visualization of synchronized RGB, 3D point clouds, and action labels for assembly tasks.

bullets: 174 sequences and ~493k frames across four furniture types
Synchronized RGB and oriented 3D point clouds from HoloLens 2
56 atomic action classes using a hierarchical (verb, noun) structure
Focuses on fine-grained interactions with small assembly components

builds.audio_segment: The IKEA Ego 3D dataset provides a comprehensive look at furniture assembly from an ego-view perspective.
It contains 174 assembly sequences and nearly 500,000 frames captured via HoloLens 2 across four furniture types.
The dataset synchronizes RGB and depth streams into oriented 3D point clouds, providing a rich multi-modal representation.
Data is annotated with 56 hierarchical action classes, using a verb-noun structure to categorize assembly steps.
This detailed structure enables the recognition of fine-grained tasks involving small components like screws and tools.
